curation.why: declaration_list and enum_member_declaration_list are the { } body wrappers. foreach_statement is control flow that carries a body, so it looks like a declaration. variable_declaration and local_declaration_statement matched on a 'type' field rather than a name — a breadcrumb reading 'decimal' helps nobody. A constructor and a local function both nest statements in real code and are worth naming in a trail, so they are added as containers even though the generator did not observe a declaration inside them. property_declaration is labelled 'variable', the same as field_declaration and event_field_declaration, so it cannot be a container without dragging those one-liners in too. A C# property with accessor bodies is scrollable and arguably deserves its own label, but 'property' is not in codemark's canonical vocabulary and the built-in C# profile makes the same trade. Revisit if the vocabulary grows.
